# App launch — Style Prompt

> The old way gets struck out, the new way slides in. A big question about a chore rises in two masked lines and a red bar strikes through it; an app window glides up out of a dark, dotted ground and its rows tick themselves done; a cursor flies in, clicks a card and a figure counts up; feature chips pop under the window; a circle of the main colour opens over everything for the name and the link. Dark, precise and product-like: a launch film that shows the thing working.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **a demo with a before and an after**. It opens on the pain in words, cancels it with one stroke, then proves the answer by letting a simplified interface do the work on its own: rows complete, a cursor acts, a number moves. The dimmed question stays above the window as context, so the viewer always sees what the interface is solving. Features come last as short chips, and the ending is a clean colour field with the name and where to get it.

Not a screen recording (the interface is drawn, simplified to four rows and one stat; no real app's chrome, menus or logos), not a feature list (three chips at most, each two or three words), not an abstract tech reel (no code rain, no glowing circuits, no 3D devices), not an explainer with a narrator's steps (the interface acts on its own, one action at a time).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **A dark ground** with a fine dot grid (2 px dots every 48 px, the text colour at 10 %) that drifts up slowly, and one large radial glow of the main colour (1300 px, 34 %) behind the window that breathes. Nothing else lives on the ground.
- **The window**: a 900 × 720 px panel with a 40 px radius on the second surface, outlined by a 2 px ring of the text colour at 10 % and lifted by a long soft shadow (0 60 px 120 px −40 px). Inside: a 96 px title bar with three dim 22 px dots and a title, four rows (88 px tall, 24 px radius, the text colour at 5 %) with a green check disc, a name and a dim status on the right, and a stat card pinned to the bottom (140 px tall, 28 px radius, the main colour at 22 %) with a label and a big figure in the accent.
- **The strike**: a 14 px rounded bar in a fixed warning red, attached to the problem line at 60 % of its height so it crosses the lowercase letters, 8 px longer than the line on each side.
- **The cursor**: a classic arrow (74 × 90 px) filled with the text colour and outlined 3 px in the background colour, so it reads on dark and light grounds alike.
- **Chips**: capsules (60 px radius, 16 × 28 px padding) in the text colour at 8 %, wrapping under the window.
- **The circle wipe**: a full-frame field of the main colour opened with `clip-path: circle()` from a point 60 % down the frame, holding an icon tile (170 px, 44 px radius), the name, one line and a link pill in the background colour.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground, the cursor's outline, the link pill on the ending.
- `--latar-2`: the window.
- `--utama`: the glow, the stat card's tint (22 %), the ending's field.
- `--aksen`: only the stat figure. It is the one number the demo produces.
- `--teks`: the question, row text, chips, the window title; its 10 %, 8 %, 5 % mixes draw the grid dots, the window ring, the chips and the rows; the cursor fill.
- `--teks-redup`: row statuses and the stat label.
- `--teks-di-utama`: the name and line on the ending, and the icon tile.
- Fixed, from the look: `--coret` (#ff5d6c) for the strike, `--centang` (#34d399) with `--teks-di-centang` (#04210f) for the check discs, `--bayangan` (#000000, used at 70 %) for the window's shadow. Red means wrong and green means done in every brand.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the question, the stat figure and the name on the ending: Space Grotesk 700 by default, a squarish grotesk that reads as software. Poppins 800 or Archivo Black hold at a smaller size (they are wider); a condensed face like Bebas Neue turns the question into a tall poster line, which also works.
- `--font-isi` carries the interface and the rest: Space Grotesk 500 and 700.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: the question 112 px (line-height 1.02, letter-spacing −3 px), the name on the ending 130 px (−4 px), the stat figure 84 px (−2 px), the ending line 58 px, the link 52 px, rows 42 px, the window title and stat label 40 px, chips 38 px, row statuses 36 px. Interface text sits under the 54 px guide on purpose: it is a picture of an interface, read as a whole, while the question, the figure and the ending carry the message at full size.
- The question is two short lines, each in its own mask; the second line holds the problem word, because that is the line the strike crosses.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Question**: each line rises from `yPercent: 110` through its mask over 0.7 s `expo.out`, staggered 0.12 s, from 0.2 s; it holds about 0.7 s.
- **Strike**: `scaleX: 0 → 1` from the left over 0.45 s `power3.inOut` at 1.6 s. Then the question drifts up 40 px and dims to 35 % (0.6 s `power2.in`) and the strike fades in 0.3 s: the problem stays as context, cancelled.
- **Window**: rises from `yPercent: 40` and scale 0.92 with a fade over 0.8 s `expo.out`, overlapping the question's dim.
- **Rows**: slide in 60 px from the right with a fade (0.5 s `power3.out`), staggered 0.28 s; each check disc pops from scale 0 with `back.out(2)` 0.25 s after its row.
- **Cursor**: flies in from 160 px right and 220 px below with a fade (0.7 s `power3.out`), glides to its target (0.6 s `power2.inOut`), clicks by scaling to 0.86 and back (0.12 s each way); the card it presses bumps to 1.03 (0.18 s each way) and its figure counts from 0 to the value over 1.6 s `power3.out`. The cursor fades 1.4 s after the click.
- **Chips**: rise 50 px with a fade, 0.5 s `back.out(1.6)`, staggered 0.15 s; then everything holds about 2 s.
- **Ending**: `clip-path: circle(0% at 50% 60%) → circle(150% at 50% 60%)` over 0.9 s `expo.inOut`; its four elements rise 70 px with a fade (0.55 s `power3.out`, staggered 0.12 s), the icon tile also turns from −20° and grows from 0.6 with `back.out(1.8)`; the link pill breathes to 1.05 (0.45 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, three breaths), and the frame fades out in the last 0.5 s.
- **Background**: the grid drifts 160 px up over 15 s, linear; the glow breathes 0.85 → 1.12 over 15 s `sine.inOut`.

## 6. Camera grammar

There is no camera move: the frame is fixed and the interface performs. The cursor is the camera's attention.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Masked question, then a strike | the old way, cancelled | a chore, a myth, a bad habit, "masih … manual?" |
| Window gliding up from below | the answer arrives | an app, a template, a course platform, a tool |
| Rows ticking done one by one | it works by itself | orders, tasks, lessons, chapters finished |
| Cursor click and a counting figure | one action, one result | revenue, time saved, followers, score |
| Chips popping under the window | what else it does | features, modules, bonuses |
| Circle wipe from below centre | the launch, the ask | the name, the free trial, the link |

## 7. Native moves

- **Struck-out question.** Two masked lines, the second one struck through in red, then dimmed to context. *Fits content like:* "Masih catat pesanan manual?" for a cashier app; "Masih edit subtitle satu-satu?" for a creator's preset pack; "Masih hafalan rumus?" for a maths class; "Dia masih menulis di buku harian…" opening a short story.
- **Self-ticking window.** The window glides up and its rows complete on their own. *Fits content like:* today's orders turning paid; a content calendar's posts going scheduled; lessons in a course turning done; a character's to-do list emptying.
- **Click to count.** A cursor flies in, clicks a stat card, the figure counts up. *Fits content like:* "Omzet hari ini Rp2.480.000"; "Waktu hemat 3 jam/minggu"; "Nilai rata-rata naik ke 88"; "Pengikut +1.200".
- **Feature chips.** Three short capsules pop under the window. *Fits content like:* "Stok otomatis / Struk via chat / Laporan harian"; "Template / Musik / Caption"; "Video / Kuis / Sertifikat".
- **Circle launch.** A main-colour circle opens over everything; icon, name, line, breathing link pill. *Fits content like:* an app's free trial and domain; a creator's template shop link; a class's registration page.

## 8. Pitfalls

- The question fills the width: "pesanan manual?" at 112 px is 902 px in Space Grotesk inside a 910 px box. A wider brand face (Archivo Black: 1026 px) wraps it to three lines, drops the strike onto the wrong line and runs into the window: size the question down (about 98 px for Archivo Black) or shorten it.
- The strike must cross the words, not sit under them: keep it inside the problem line's own span, at about 60 % of the line height for lowercase (about 50 % for an all-caps face).
- An interface with real-app chrome (status bars, a known app's icons, a browser's address bar) dates the film and imitates a product that is not the user's. Keep it a plain, simplified window.
- Every value in the window (names, statuses, the figure) is content: use the user's real feature names and numbers, never invented revenue or user counts.
- More than four rows or three chips crowd the window and the bottom safe zone (the chips end around 1500 px, the safe zone starts at 1500).
- The icon tile on the ending is where the brand's logo goes. With no logo, remove the tile and let the name carry the ending; never draw a made-up logo.
- The dot grid and the glow move every frame and are bigger than the frame, which is what makes this look expensive in a phone preview. Keep the grid only as big as its drift needs (frame width, 200 px taller) and filled with `--latar` so it is opaque; give the glow `will-change: transform` so it is drawn once and only scaled; and hide both once the ending covers the frame. Together that is about a third of the work of a full-bleed transparent grid redrawn every frame.
- On a light brand ground, the long black shadow under the window is strong: lower `--bayangan`'s mix (40-50 %) rather than removing it, or the window floats flat.

# App launch: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.6, long 3.

## hook

- en: the problem rises in two masked lines, a red bar strikes the second, then it dims to context
- id: masalah naik dua baris bermasker, garis merah mencoret baris kedua, lalu meredup jadi konteks

## problem

- en: a messy manual screen: rows unticked, the status in red
- id: layar manual yang berantakan: baris belum dicentang, status merah

## fact

- en: the app window glides up and scales in; its rows slide in and tick one by one
- id: jendela aplikasi naik dan membesar, barisnya masuk dan tercentang satu per satu

## step

- en: the cursor glides to the next control and clicks it
- id: kursor meluncur ke kontrol berikutnya lalu mengkliknya

## compare

- en: the old screen is struck out, the new window glides up over it
- id: layar lama dicoret, jendela baru naik menutupinya

## number

- en: the cursor flies in and clicks a stat card; its figure counts up in the accent
- id: kursor masuk dan mengklik kartu statistik, angkanya dihitung naik berwarna aksen

## proof

- en: the window zooms to one row with a single callout
- id: jendela di-zoom ke satu baris dengan satu keterangan

## offer

- en: feature chips pop up one by one under the app window
- id: chip fitur muncul satu per satu di bawah jendela aplikasi

## cta

- en: a main-colour circle opens; icon, name and line rise, the link pill breathes, held 2 s
- id: lingkaran warna utama terbuka; ikon, nama, dan kalimat naik, pil tautan bernapas, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the finished window holds, every row ticked, 2 s
- id: jendela selesai diam dengan semua baris tercentang, 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Peluncuran aplikasi</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Coret, centang, dan bayangan milik gaya ini. */
      :root {
        --latar: #070b18; --latar-2: #111a33; --utama: #3159ff; --aksen: #73c8ff;
        --teks: #f2f5ff; --teks-redup: #8d97b5; --teks-di-utama: #f2f5ff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #3159ff; --aksen-di-latar: #73c8ff;
        --font-judul: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --coret: #ff5d6c; --centang: #34d399; --teks-di-centang: #04210f; --bayangan: #000000;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      /* Grid titik: selebar layar, 200px lebih tinggi untuk geseran 160px, dan buram (warna latar) supaya murah digeser tiap frame. */
      .grid { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: -200px; background-color: var(--latar);
        background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent) 2px, transparent 2px);
        background-size: 48px 48px; background-position: -8px -8px; }
      /* Cahaya yang bernapas: lapisan sendiri, digambar sekali lalu diskalakan (hemat raster). */
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1300px; height: 1300px; left: -110px; top: 420px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 34%, transparent), transparent 62%); will-change: transform; }
      .hook { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 80px; top: 270px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 112px; font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -3px; }
      .hook .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .hook .line span { display: block; width: fit-content; position: relative; }
      /* Coretan menempel di baris masalah, melintang setinggi huruf kecil, jadi ikut panjang teks dan fontnya. */
      .strike { position: absolute; left: -8px; right: -8px; top: calc(60% - 7px); height: 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--coret);
        transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Jendela aplikasi di permukaan kedua. */
      .app { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 580px; height: 720px; border-radius: 40px; background: var(--latar-2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent), 0 60px 120px -40px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayangan) 70%, transparent);
        overflow: hidden; }
      .bar { height: 96px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0 40px; border-bottom: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 8%, transparent); }
      .dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 18%, transparent); }
      .bar b { margin-left: 16px; font-size: 40px; }
      .rows { padding: 34px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
      .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 26px; height: 88px; padding: 0 30px; border-radius: 24px;
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 5%, transparent); font-size: 42px; }
      .check { width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--centang); color: var(--teks-di-centang); display: grid; place-items: center;
        font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; }
      .row em { margin-left: auto; font-style: normal; color: var(--teks-redup); font-size: 36px; }
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 40px; right: 40px; bottom: 30px; height: 140px; border-radius: 28px; padding: 0 40px; display: flex; align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, transparent); }
      .stat span { font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .stat b { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 84px; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); letter-spacing: -2px; }
      /* Kursor: isi warna teks, garis warna latar, jadi tetap terlihat di latar gelap maupun terang. */
      .cursor { position: absolute; left: 700px; top: 1400px; width: 74px; height: 90px; }
      .cursor path { fill: var(--teks); stroke: var(--latar); }
      .chips { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 1325px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px 18px; }
      .chip { padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 60px; font-size: 38px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 8%, transparent); }
      /* Penutup: lingkaran warna utama, teks di atasnya memakai --teks-di-utama. */
      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
        justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 0 90px; }
      .end .logo { width: 170px; height: 170px; border-radius: 44px; background: var(--teks-di-utama); }
      .end .nama { margin-top: 48px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 130px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -4px; }
      .end .ajak { margin-top: 24px; font-size: 58px; font-weight: 500; }
      .end .url { margin-top: 56px; padding: 26px 60px; border-radius: 80px; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-size: 52px; font-weight: 700; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
      <div class="glow" id="glow"></div>
      <div class="hook" id="hook" data-role="hook">
        <span class="line"><span>Masih catat</span></span>
        <span class="line"><span>pesanan manual?<i class="strike" id="strike"></i></span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="app" id="app" data-role="fact">
        <div class="bar"><i class="dot"></i><i class="dot"></i><i class="dot"></i><b>Pesanan hari ini</b></div>
        <div class="rows">
          <div class="row"><i class="check">✓</i>Bu Sari, 3 item<em>Lunas</em></div>
          <div class="row"><i class="check">✓</i>Pak Didi, 1 item<em>Dikirim</em></div>
          <div class="row"><i class="check">✓</i>Mbak Rani, 5 item<em>Lunas</em></div>
          <div class="row"><i class="check">✓</i>Kak Bima, 2 item<em>Diproses</em></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat"><span>Omzet hari ini</span><b id="omzet">Rp0</b></div>
      </div>
      <svg class="cursor" id="cursor" data-role="number" viewBox="0 0 37 45"><path d="M2 2 L2 36 L11 28 L17 42 L23 39 L17 26 L30 26 Z" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" /></svg>
      <div class="chips" id="chips" data-role="offer">
        <span class="chip">Stok otomatis</span><span class="chip">Struk via Chat</span><span class="chip">Laporan harian</span>
      </div>
      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="logo"></div>
        <div class="nama">Kasirku</div>
        <div class="ajak">Gratis 14 hari, tanpa kartu kredit</div>
        <div class="url">kasirku.id</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const fmt = (n) => "Rp" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");

      // Latar hidup pelan sepanjang video.
      tl.fromTo("#grid", { y: 0 }, { y: -160, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.85 }, { scale: 1.12, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);

      // Pembuka: masalah, lalu dicoret.
      tl.from("#hook .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 0.2)
        .fromTo("#strike", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 1.6)
        .to("#hook", { y: -40, opacity: 0.35, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.in" }, 2.3)
        .to("#strike", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 2.4);

      // Aplikasi meluncur masuk, baris tercentang satu per satu.
      tl.from("#app", { yPercent: 40, opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.4)
        .from(".row", { x: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.28 }, 3.1)
        .from(".check", { scale: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(2)", stagger: 0.28 }, 3.35);

      // Kursor menekan kartu omzet, angkanya naik.
      const uang = { v: 0 };
      const omzet = document.getElementById("omzet");
      tl.from("#cursor", { x: 160, y: 220, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "power3.out" }, 4.6)
        .to("#cursor", { x: -40, y: -200, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 5.3)
        .to("#cursor", { scale: 0.86, duration: 0.12, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 5.9)
        .to(".stat", { scale: 1.03, duration: 0.18, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 5.95)
        .to(uang, { v: 2480000, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { omzet.textContent = fmt(uang.v); } }, 6.0)
        .to("#cursor", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 7.4);

      // Fitur sebagai chip, lalu penutup dengan wipe.
      tl.from(".chip", { y: 50, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)", stagger: 0.15 }, 7.6)
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "circle(0% at 50% 60%)" }, { clipPath: "circle(150% at 50% 60%)", duration: 0.9, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 10.2)
        // Lingkaran sudah menutup seluruh layar: latar di bawahnya tidak perlu digambar lagi.
        .set(["#grid", "#glow"], { visibility: "hidden" }, 11.1)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 10.8)
        .from(".end .logo", { rotation: -20, scale: 0.6, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 10.8)
        .to(".end .url", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 11.8)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      /* Grid titik: selebar layar, 200px lebih tinggi untuk geseran 160px, dan buram (warna latar) supaya murah digeser tiap frame. */
      .grid { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: -200px; background-color: var(--latar);
        background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent) 2px, transparent 2px);
        background-size: 48px 48px; background-position: -8px -8px; }
      /* Cahaya yang bernapas: lapisan sendiri, digambar sekali lalu diskalakan (hemat raster). */
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1300px; height: 1300px; left: 710px; top: -130px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 34%, transparent), transparent 62%); will-change: transform; }
      /* Lebar: masalah dan fitur di kolom kiri, jendela aplikasi di kolom kanan. */
      .hook { position: absolute; left: 110px; width: 760px; top: 220px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 92px; font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -3px; }
      .hook .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .hook .line span { display: block; width: fit-content; position: relative; white-space: nowrap; }
      /* Coretan menempel di baris masalah, melintang setinggi huruf kecil, jadi ikut panjang teks dan fontnya. */
      .strike { position: absolute; left: -8px; right: -8px; top: calc(60% - 7px); height: 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--coret);
        transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Jendela aplikasi di permukaan kedua. */
      .app { position: absolute; left: 920px; right: 110px; top: 160px; height: 740px; border-radius: 40px; background: var(--latar-2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent), 0 60px 120px -40px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayangan) 70%, transparent);
        overflow: hidden; }
      .bar { height: 96px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0 40px; border-bottom: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 8%, transparent); }
      .dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 18%, transparent); }
      .bar b { margin-left: 16px; font-size: 40px; }
      .rows { padding: 34px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
      .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 26px; height: 88px; padding: 0 30px; border-radius: 24px;
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 5%, transparent); font-size: 42px; }
      .check { width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--centang); color: var(--teks-di-centang); display: grid; place-items: center;

      .row em { margin-left: auto; font-style: normal; color: var(--teks-redup); font-size: 36px; }
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 40px; right: 40px; bottom: 30px; height: 140px; border-radius: 28px; padding: 0 40px; display: flex; align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, transparent); }
      .stat span { font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); white-space: nowrap; }

      /* Kursor: isi warna teks, garis warna latar, jadi tetap terlihat di latar gelap maupun terang. */
      .cursor { position: absolute; left: 1500px; top: 960px; width: 74px; height: 90px; }

      .chips { position: absolute; left: 110px; width: 760px; top: 520px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px 18px; }

      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const fmt = (n) => "Rp" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");

      // Latar hidup pelan sepanjang video.
      tl.fromTo("#grid", { y: 0 }, { y: -160, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.85 }, { scale: 1.12, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);

      // Pembuka: masalah, lalu dicoret.
      tl.from("#hook .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 0.2)
        .fromTo("#strike", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 1.6)
        .to("#hook", { y: -40, opacity: 0.35, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.in" }, 2.3)
        .to("#strike", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 2.4);

      // Aplikasi meluncur masuk, baris tercentang satu per satu.
      tl.from("#app", { yPercent: 40, opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.4)
        .from(".row", { x: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.28 }, 3.1)
        .from(".check", { scale: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(2)", stagger: 0.28 }, 3.35);

      // Kursor menekan kartu omzet, angkanya naik.
      const uang = { v: 0 };
      const omzet = document.getElementById("omzet");
      tl.from("#cursor", { x: 160, y: 220, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "power3.out" }, 4.6)
        .to("#cursor", { x: -40, y: -200, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 5.3)
        .to("#cursor", { scale: 0.86, duration: 0.12, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 5.9)
        .to(".stat", { scale: 1.03, duration: 0.18, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 5.95)
        .to(uang, { v: 2480000, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { omzet.textContent = fmt(uang.v); } }, 6.0)
        .to("#cursor", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 7.4);

      // Fitur sebagai chip, lalu penutup dengan wipe.
      tl.from(".chip", { y: 50, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)", stagger: 0.15 }, 7.6)
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "circle(0% at 50% 60%)" }, { clipPath: "circle(150% at 50% 60%)", duration: 0.9, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 10.2)
        // Lingkaran sudah menutup seluruh layar: latar di bawahnya tidak perlu digambar lagi.
        .set(["#grid", "#glow"], { visibility: "hidden" }, 11.1)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 10.8)
        .from(".end .logo", { rotation: -20, scale: 0.6, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 10.8)
        .to(".end .url", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 11.8)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
